example: The new procedure is anything but simple.

examples.en: The new procedure is anything but simple.
examples.highlight: The new procedure is anything but simple.

rules.zh: 目標表達【anything but】表示強烈否定在這個句型中，anything but 並不是指「任何東西」，而是表示：【not at all；far from；certainly not】 一點也不……絕非……遠非……這個房間一點也不安靜。 這句通常暗示房間非常嘈吵，而不只是「不太安靜」。
rules.en: anything but not at all far from certainly not The room is anything but quiet.

rules.zh: 比 not very 強烈這個程序不太簡單。 這句只表示程序有一點困難。這個程序一點也不簡單。 這句表示程序肯定不簡單，而且可能非常複雜。因此，anything but 不應用來表達輕微或不肯定的否定。
rules.en: anything but The procedure is not very simple. The procedure is anything but simple.

rules.zh: 核心固定結構只有 anything but + adjective 以下都是完整的核心結構：【anything but simple；anything but reliable；anything but pleasant；anything but practical】 句子前後的其他部分只是句法外殼或補充資料，並不是固定結構的一部分。三句使用的核心結構都是：【anything but practical】 目標表達【Although, after the costs were calculated】等部分只是提供額外資料。
rules.en: anything but simple anything but reliable anything but pleasant anything but practical The plan is anything but practical. Although the plan looks attractive, it is anything but practical. The plan was anything but practical after the costs were calculated. anything but practical Although, after the costs were calculated

rules.zh: 動詞可以配合不同時態和主語改變。現在式：這個方法一點也不可靠。這些指示一點也不清楚。過去式：這段旅程一點也不舒適。這些討論一點也不簡短。完成式：談判進展一直一點也不順利。這個過程一直一點也不透明。未來式：最後階段絕不會簡單直接。
rules.en: be The method is anything but reliable. The instructions are anything but clear. The journey was anything but comfortable. The discussions were anything but brief. The negotiations have been anything but smooth. The process had been anything but transparent. The final stage will be anything but straightforward.

rules.zh: 可以放在情態動詞後面未來幾個月可能非常難以預測。 這項任務可能一點也不容易。 這段旅程絕不會舒適。 情態動詞本身表達可能性、預測或判斷；anything but + adjective 仍然是核心結構。
rules.en: Subject + modal verb + be + anything but + adjective. The next few months may be anything but predictable. The task could be anything but easy. The journey will be anything but comfortable.

rules.zh: 可以跟在其他連繫動詞後面除了 be，anything but + adjective 亦可跟在表示觀感、狀態或結果的連繫動詞後面。這個計劃看來一點也不實際。 情況看來一點也不穩定。 這個房間看來一點也不舒適宜人。 這個解釋聽起來一點也不具說服力。 這個道歉讓人感到一點也不真誠。 這座大樓仍然一點也不安全。 這項任務結果一點也不簡單。 較便宜的選擇結果一點也不合乎經濟效益。 這些連繫動詞是可用的句法外殼，但核心表達仍然是：【anything but + adjective】
rules.en: seem The plan seems anything but practical. appear The situation appears anything but stable. look The room looks anything but welcoming. sound The explanation sounds anything but convincing. feel The apology felt anything but sincere. remain The building remains anything but safe. prove The task proved anything but simple. turn out to be The cheaper choice turned out to be anything but economical. anything but + adjective

rules.zh: 形容詞前不要使用副詞形式後面需要形容詞，用來描述主語。
rules.en: The procedure is anything but simple. The procedure is anything but simply. anything but

rules.zh: 遇上否定形容詞時，要小心雙重否定職員絕非沒有幫助，換言之，他們非常樂於幫忙。 目標表達【anything but】會否定後面的形容詞：【anything but friendly】 一點也不友善絕非不友善，通常暗示十分友善初學者應先集中練習 positive adjective，例如 simple、clear、safe 和 reliable，以免混淆。
rules.en: The staff were anything but unhelpful. anything but anything but friendly anything but unfriendly

rules.zh: 不要與「except」的用法混淆這項任務一點也不容易。 除了魚以外，我甚麼都會吃。 第二句中的 anything but 表示「除了……以外的任何東西」，並不是本課的目標結構。
rules.en: Anything but + adjective: The task was anything but easy. Anything but + noun: I will eat anything but fish.

rules.zh: 不要與 nothing but 混淆這個答案一點幫助也沒有。 盒子裏只有舊文件。 兩個結構的意思完全不同。
rules.en: anything but + adjective ＝ definitely not The answer was anything but helpful. nothing but + noun ＝ only The box contained nothing but old papers.

rules.zh: 不要混淆【anything but impossible】和【all but impossible】：前者表示「絕非不可能」，後者表示「幾乎不可能」。這個計劃絕非不可能。這個計劃幾乎不可能實行。這個程序一點也不簡單。 這段旅程可能一點也不舒適。 這些討論一直毫無成果。 這個解決方法看來一點也不實際。 雖然這部裝置外表現代化，但一點也不方便使用。 由於這條道路一點也不安全，居民都會避開它。
rules.en: anything but impossible all but impossible The plan is anything but impossible. The plan is all but impossible. After be Subject + be + anything but + adjective. The procedure is anything but simple. After a modal verb Subject + modal + be + anything but + adjective. The journey may be anything but comfortable. With perfect tenses Subject + has / have / had been + anything but + adjective. The discussions have been anything but productive. After another linking verb Subject + seem / appear / look / sound / feel / remain / prove + anything but + adjective. The solution seems anything but practical. Inside a subordinate clause Although / Because / If + subject + linking verb + anything but + adjective, main clause. Although the device looks modern, it is anything but user-friendly. Because the road is anything but safe, residents avoid it.

rules.zh: 檢查人員認為，這個出口一點也不方便到達。 這通看似普通的電話一點也不普通。 一項排斥兼職員工的政策一點也不具包容性。 這篇演說一點也不鼓舞人心，令觀眾感到失望。 這是較高階的可選延伸，並不是最基本的句式。初學者應先掌握：【Subject + be + anything but + adjective.】
rules.en: Inside a reported or embedded clause Subject + reporting verb + that + subject + be + anything but + adjective. The inspectors concluded that the exit was anything but accessible. After a longer subject Long noun phrase / noun clause + be + anything but + adjective. What appeared to be a routine call was anything but routine. A policy that excludes part-time workers is anything but inclusive. Fronted adjective phrase Anything but + adjective, + subject + verb. Anything but inspiring, the speech left the audience disappointed. Subject + be + anything but + adjective.

benefits.zh: 表達強烈而清楚的否定這個句型能明確告訴讀者，某事物完全不具備某種特質。這項服務一點也不可靠。 讀者會明白服務並非只是偶爾出錯，而是非常不可靠。
benefits.en: The service is anything but reliable.

benefits.zh: 把較長的說法縮短你可以用較少字數表達相同的強烈意思。
benefits.en: Instead of: The new procedure is not simple in any way. You can write: The new procedure is anything but simple.

benefits.zh: 適合指出現實與預期不同這個句型經常用來說明某事物看似具有某種特質，但實際情況完全不同。這項據說容易的任務一點也不容易。 它特別適合用於評論、故事、報告和議論文。
benefits.en: The supposedly easy task was anything but easy.

benefits.zh: 讓評價更有力度相比普通的 not，anything but 能使意見更明確。這個解釋不清楚。 這個解釋一點也不清楚。 第二句的批評更強烈。
benefits.en: The explanation was not clear. The explanation was anything but clear.

benefits.zh: 提供多種自然句法選擇掌握核心表達後，你可以把它放在不同句法外殼中：【is anything but clear；may be anything but clear；seems anything but clear；has been anything but clear；although it is anything but clear；a report that is anything but clear】 這能令說話和寫作的句式更有變化，而不是每句都使用相同開頭。
benefits.en: is anything but clear may be anything but clear seems anything but clear has been anything but clear although it is anything but clear a report that is anything but clear
